question: Where is the nearest nature reserve located on the southwest side relative to South University, Austin, Round Rock, TX?
sql: WITH ref_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%South University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Austin%' -- Assuming Austin is the primary city for the university AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.park_name, p.leisure FROM parks AS p, ref_point AS rp WHERE p.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid(rp.geometry), ST_Centroid(p.geometry) )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5 -- Southwest direction (202.5 to 247.5 degrees) ORDER BY p.geometry <-> rp.geometry LIMIT 1;
